issues.quote: ## A delivery won the Round, whoever won: hide. The Round-over screen takes the view, and the  (line 155; also line 35: "counting -> hidden    the controller emitted round_over: a delivery won (Story 004 AC-6), the")
issues.problem: Stale since Story 008: round_over is now also emitted for a loss and for a double loss, and the loser's countdown really does go counting -> hidden on it (it starts on unit_destroyed in the same controller tick, then round_over hides it; measured in the loss and token_ui scenarios). The class doc calls its state table complete, but it names a delivery as the only reason. The same table (line 37) and line 156 also claim the restart emits unit_spawned for every Player; MatchController.restart() emits round_started only and its doc says no unit_spawned goes out there (false since Story 005, still in the file).
issues.fix: Line 35: "the controller emitted round_over: the Round ended (a delivery, a loss or a double loss)"; line 155: "The Round ended, whoever won or nobody: hide."; lines 37 and 156: the restart announces itself with round_started, and unit_spawned follows per Player once chosen.

issues.quote: ## It runs while the tree is paused. The win freezes the game with get_tree().paused = true, and  (line 22); line 17: "## Flags, spawns the Units, unpauses the tree and emits round_started. It owns no state, so a"
issues.problem: A loss and a double loss freeze the game with the same pause (Story 008), so 'the win' is no longer the only cause; and restart() benches the Units and the Players choose, it does not spawn them (its own doc in match_controller.gd says so). The story edited the neighbouring line 16/17 (canisters -> Flags) without correcting it.
issues.fix: "The end of a Round (a delivery, a loss or a double loss) freezes the game with get_tree().paused = true" and "Flags, benches the Units with their Players choosing, unpauses the tree and emits round_started".

issues.quote: ## the pause unstepped. The pause of a won Round ends in restart() after every Player was benched,  (line 122); line 215: "## against, so a bench during the pause of a won Round is due on the first tick after the unpause."
issues.problem: A Round now also pauses when it is lost or lost by both Players (nobody won); 'won Round' reads as if only a delivery pauses. The behaviour is the same code path (measured: T30 restarts after a delivery, a loss and a double loss).
issues.fix: Say 'an ended Round' (or 'the pause at the end of a Round') in both places.

issues.quote: ## Player 1) and the index of its Base in the controller's arrays, so bases[N].Flag is Player  (line 20); line 62: "## The Flag of the given index: bases[flag_index].Flag."; same slip in src/gameplay/maps/base.gd:64 "## MatchController asks it for spawn_point, spare_spawn_points, Flag and flag_seat and" and tools/evidence/split_screen/flag_kit.gd:35 "Flag N is bases[N].Flag"
issues.problem: The rename turned the identifier `canister` into the class name `Flag` inside prose that names a member; the Base export is `flag` (base.gd: `@export var flag: Flag`), so the docs name a member that does not exist.
issues.fix: bases[N].flag, bases[flag_index].flag, and 'flag and flag_seat' in those four lines.

issues.fix: Write ("flags", project.godot) and "flags" in both places.

Also the engine reference (breaking-changes, deprecated-apis, current-best-practices, ui/input modules) and .claude/rules/ui-code.md and gameplay-code.md: the change contradicts nothing in them. Ran, always in a scratch copy and one Godot process at a time: the parse check, a fresh --import with a byte compare of the class cache, the 31-scenario regress, the 7 new scenarios (twice, plus at 30 and 144 fps), launch/frozen/assets, input_ghosting_check --self-test, seven small probes (duplicate sharing, typed dictionary assignment and .tres loading, Label colour override, StyleBox connections, pause ordering, HUD rects at wider views, packed-array propagation) and a throwaway fuzz (7 seeds x 12000 ticks and a driving variant). Found no engine-level defect in the game code: the Token is taken before any signal, begin() validates before it changes anything, restart() refills before round_started, the cursor search is bounded, the Round-over screen and R work while paused, node lookups (%TokensLabel, %FlagStatusLabel, Lines/NameLabel, Lines/CountLabel, flag/flag_seat exports) all resolve, and nothing writes to the shared TokenStock/UnitStats/MatchRules. What remains is documentation and naming: one stale class doc (respawn_countdown.gd), a few stale or wrong phrases, rename slips that turned the member `flag` into `Flag` in prose, the layer name quoted as \"Flags\", and two leftover canister abbreviations (`_cans`, `1_wc`). Not checked: windowed real-time rendering and GPU frame pacing (fps, map_fps), the Windows export, how the editor re-saves the hand-written scenes, GDScript analyzer warnings (not visible from the CLI), accessibility and translation, documents outside code (README, rules, CONTEXT, TD register, evidence doc, the story file), the design/acceptance coverage judged by the other lenses, windows of other aspect ratios beyond the one HUD probe, and the second half of tokens_showcase.gd and tokens_showcase_kit.gd, which I skimmed rather than read line by line (their run and output were checked)."
